shots.headline: What should this print cost?
shots.sub: Type grams, hours and labour. Read the price, the marketplace fees and the profit. Google Sheets and Excel.

shots.headline: Your printer, your prices
shots.sub: Power draw, electricity, wear, failure buffer, labour rate and pricing mode on one tab. Material prices per kg feed the dropdowns; add your own.

shots.headline: See where the money goes
shots.sub: Material, energy, wear, failure buffer, labour and extras per unit, with each item's share of the total.

shots.headline: Etsy fees, built in
shots.sub: Transaction 6.5%, payment 3% + $0.25, listing $0.20 and offsite ads when they apply. Shopify, eBay, direct and a custom channel too; every number is editable.

quote.note: the fees applied to this print, and the price for your target margin after fees

shots.headline: Price 30 jobs at once
shots.sub: One row per job on the Batch tab: unit cost, price, profit and a below-cost check for each, with totals and average margin at the bottom.

shots.headline: Google Sheets and Excel 2016+
shots.sub: No macros, no add-ons, formulas you can inspect.
notes: Open the .xlsx in Excel, or upload it to Google Drive and open with Sheets.
Sheets are protected against accidental edits; unprotect with no password.
Plain formulas only: IF, VLOOKUP, IFERROR, SUM, CEILING, TEXT.
shots.formula_caption: Batch!T5, the unit-cost cell: material + energy + wear + failure buffer + labour + post-processing + shipping

faq.a: Instant download after purchase: one .xlsx file and a Read-Me-First PDF.
Both. Excel 2016 or newer, or upload to Google Drive and open with Sheets. No macros or add-ons.

faq.q: What can I do with it?
faq.a: Personal and small-business use on your own devices. Please do not resell or share the file.

faq.q: Is this tax or financial advice?
faq.a: No. It is a pricing tool with the numbers you type in; taxes, VAT and overheads are yours to add.
Updated versions are added to the same listing; re-download from your Etsy purchases at no charge.
